roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.subtitle: A role is a named bundle of permissions, and every member holds exactly one. Invent as many as the workspace needs — a Director who shapes the map without being able to remove people is a role, not a compromise.
roles.settingsHint: Invent roles, choose what each one can do, and see how many people hold it.
roles.fixedTitle: You invent the roles. The permissions are fixed.
roles.fixedBody: The switches below are the whole list, and it is set by what this app actually checks — a permission is a promise the code keeps, so a switch nobody reads would grant nothing and tell you it had. New switches arrive when new abilities are built, never from this screen.
roles.loadFailed: The roles could not be loaded.
roles.emptyHint: Roles arrive with the workspace. If this list is empty, the migration that adds them has not run against this project.
roles.missingTableHint: Roles live in migration 0025. Apply it to this project and reload.
roles.permHint: Each line says what it lets a holder do, in the app's own terms. Nothing here is a category — it is the action itself.
roles.permWorkspaceAdminEffect: Create and delete accounts and change anyone's role, including yours; edit tracks, the map, the words the app uses and every setting; and read the record of who changed what.
roles.permMembersManageEffect: Create, rename and delete roles on this screen, tick and untick these switches, and move a colleague from one role to another. It does not create or delete accounts — that still asks for the switch above.
roles.permStructureEditEffect: Add, rename, move and archive the tracks, programmes, phases and organizations the map is drawn from.
roles.permVocabEditEffect: Add and rename the statuses, types and priorities every item is filed under, and the use cases an organization is onboarded onto.
roles.permCaptureWriteEffect: Create items and update them, and record which use cases an organization has integrated.
roles.reachDeclaredNote: Nothing checks this switch yet — the screens it will gate still ask for the top one. Turning it on is recorded and safe, and it starts working the day those screens read it.
roles.lastAdminReason: This is the only role that can administer the workspace, and somebody holds it. Turning this off would leave nobody able to turn it back on — not even you — and it could only be repaired from the database itself. Give another role this switch first.
roles.unknownPerm: This role holds ⁨{name}⁩, which this version of the app does not know about. It is safe: the app enforces only what it understands. Reload to pick up a newer build.
roles.createHint: A new role starts with nothing switched on. Give it a name, then choose what it can do.
roles.createKeyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores. This is the name code and migrations use, and it can never be changed — the labels above can.
roles.nameArHint: Shown while the app is in Arabic. Leave it empty to fall back to the English name.
roles.nameRequired: Give the role an English name of 40 characters or fewer.
roles.deleteBody: The role and everything it grants go. Nobody holds it, so no one loses access.
roles.deleteSystemReason: Built-in roles cannot be deleted. Every new sign-in lands on one, and the app works out who administers the workspace by looking at them. Change what this one grants instead.

deleteInUseReason.one: {count} member holds this role. Move them to another role first — deleting it would take away every permission they have.
deleteInUseReason.other: {count} members hold this role. Move them to another role first — deleting it would take away every permission they have.

roles.errLastAdmin: That would leave the workspace with nobody able to administer it. Give another role that switch first.
roles.errSystem: That role is built in and cannot be deleted.
roles.errInUse: Somebody still holds that role. Move them first.
roles.errKeyImmutable: A role's key is its machine name and cannot be changed. Rename the label instead.
roles.errUnknownPerm: The database does not recognise that permission. This build is ahead of the database — reload, and apply any pending migration.
roles.errNameTaken: Another role already uses that English name.
roles.errNameArTaken: Another role already uses that Arabic name.
roles.errKeyTaken: Another role already uses that key.
roles.errKeyShape: A key is lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starts with a letter, and is 2 to 32 long.
roles.errNameLength: A role name has to be between 1 and 40 characters.
